# Project Phoenix v45.0 — Global Situation 3: Age of Atlantic & Constitutional Revolutions (1775-1830).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v45_rev_fervor` -100..+100).
# Generated by gen_v450_world_situations.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v45_atlantic_revolutions = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v45_atlantic_revolutions

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1775
		current_year <= 1830
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_rev_ended }
		any_country = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations >= 12
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					continent = continent:america
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			is_revolutionary = yes
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					continent = continent:america
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Dawn of Constitutional Sovereignty (oe_v45_rev_fervor >= 75)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_rev_end_constitutional_dawn"
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_end_constitutional_dawn_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_rev_fervor }
				var:oe_v45_rev_fervor >= 75
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 12
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_rev_constitutional_dawn years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Legitimist Concert of Crowns (oe_v45_rev_fervor <= -75)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_rev_end_conservative_concert"
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_end_conservative_concert_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_rev_fervor }
				var:oe_v45_rev_fervor <= -75
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_participant
					}
				}
				add_stability = 6
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_rev_conservative_concert years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Trans-Atlantic Constitutional Equilibrium (1830 conclusion)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_rev_end_balanced_charters"
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_end_balanced_charters_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1830
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_rev_balanced_charters years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor value = 10 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_13_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_13_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_participant value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.13
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_rev_fervor } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor value = 10 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v45_rev_fervor < 68
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						is_revolutionary = yes
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_declaration_rights
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor add = 0.35 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v45_rev_fervor > -68
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_conservative_concert
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor add = -0.35 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_rev_fervor > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_rev_fervor < -100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_fervor value = -100 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_rev_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_rev_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						is_revolutionary = yes
						government_type = government_type:republic
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_constitutional_camp
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_rev_map_constitutional_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { has_variable = oe_v45_rev_moderate_camp }
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_rev_map_moderate_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_concert_camp
						government_type = government_type:monarchy
					}
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_rev_map_concert_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						is_revolutionary = yes
						government_type = government_type:republic
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_constitutional_camp
					}
				}
			}
			value = red_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= { has_variable = oe_v45_rev_moderate_camp }
			}
			value = green
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner ?= {
					OR = {
						has_variable = oe_v45_rev_concert_camp
						government_type = government_type:monarchy
					}
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_legend_constitutional"
		color = rgb { 196 58 68 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_legend_moderate"
		color = rgb { 74 152 108 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_rev_legend_concert"
		color = rgb { 52 84 148 }
	}
}
